snippet.title: Magus in Mystic Geometries Stage 1
snippet.description: This is a fun little Touhou fan game where you control Patchouli and... shoot things in a survival mode type of gameplay.  There is no real end to each stage (except for stage 5) so it just ends when you lose all of your extra lives, but after getting up to certain scores, you are awarded bronze, silver, and gold medals once the stage ends.
